descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines and data processing solutions.
Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for integrating data from multiple sources.
Develop and maintain data architectures, data models, and data integration workflows.
Work with large datasets and implement efficient data transformation and processing solutions.
Ensure data quality, consistency, security, and availability across data platforms.
Optimize data workflows and troubleshoot performance or data-related issues.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders.
Contribute to technical architecture decisions and recommend improvements to existing data solutions.
Document technical solutions and communicate effectively with German-speaking stakeholders.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or a similar role.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or SQL.
Solid experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline development.
Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of data warehousing, data lakes, and distributed data processing.
Experience with technologies such as Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or similar frameworks.
Good understanding of database technologies, both relational and non-relational.
Experience with data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or similar solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within international teams.
 German language skills – minimum B2 level. 
Good command of English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or Azure Synapse Analytics.
Knowledge of Kafka or other streaming technologies.
Experience with Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with data governance, data security, and data quality frameworks.
Experience working in Agile environments.
